definitions.explanation: A character written or typed incorrectly. Unlike English typos, which involve wrong letters, Japanese 誤字 typically involves writing the wrong kanji, using an incorrect homophone, or mixing up similar-looking characters. Composed of 誤 (mistake) + 字 (character).

examples.japanese: この{書類|しょるい}には{誤字|ごじ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This document has a lot of typos.

examples.japanese: {提出|ていしゅつ}する{前|まえ}に{誤字|ごじ}{脱字|だつじ}がないか{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check for typos and omitted characters before submitting.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly paired with {脱字|だつじ} (omitted characters) in the set phrase {誤字|ごじ}{脱字|だつじ}, often abbreviated to {誤字|ごじ}{脱|だつ}. This combination covers both wrong characters and missing characters, similar to English "typos and omissions."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤字|ごじ}{脱字|だつじ} (typos and omitted characters)
- {誤字|ごじ}を{直|なお}す (to fix a typo)
- {誤字|ごじ}を{見|み}つける (to find a typo)
- {誤字|ごじ}が{目立|めだ}つ (typos are noticeable)
